Per-horizon top-5 (smape) adapts to unstable ranking: different models dominate at different steps, and the series has strong trend+seasonality where horizon-specific skill matters. Complements the global-weight strategies already tested.

Error-trend weighting adapts to models improving/degrading across windows; useful when ranking is unstable (tau=0.244) and static inverse-error or per-horizon top-k may overfit to window-specific noise

Small diverse pool: one model per independent error group, simple mean avoids weight estimation with only 3 windows; captures both statistical trend (ETS, THETA) and ML flexibility (rf, catboost) plus seasonal anchor (NaiveSeasonal)
